run_print_log_reader: run the PrintLogReader on a Cuberite log directory to print all Minecraft server hook events
run_print_log_reader_only: run the PrintLogReader with --only flags to print only specific hook events from a log directory
run_print_log_reader_ignore: run the PrintLogReader with --ignore flags to skip specific hook events from a log directory
review_PrintLogReader_class: review the PrintLogReader class that dynamically creates on_hook_name methods for each hook in HOOK_MAP
review_PrintLogReader_init: review the PrintLogReader __init__ that filters hooks via only_hooks or ignore_hooks parameters
